# SOPHIA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 12
**Agent:** SOPHIA (Consensus)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 17-18 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 12

---

**12:1** Peter answered and spoke concerning these same things.

**12:2** He questioned them about the Savior: "Did he really speak with a woman without our knowledge and not openly? Are we to turn about and all listen to her? Did he prefer her to us?"

---

*Council Note (SOPHIA):* EMET and LOGOS are in full agreement here. PNEUMA's "defer to her" and "choose her over us" are interpretively accurate but go beyond the Coptic vocabulary. The literal questions are blunt enough to stand without sharpening. EMET/LOGOS adopted throughout.
